text:
Maya: FYI billing spike in us-west1 GPUs this morning — roughly $48k overrun in last 24h. Most costs are tagged as `platform-pool` but the compute traces look like Search workloads. Anyone digging in?

Arun: On it, pulling Cloud Billing export and gce instance inventory. Running a quick GROUP BY on labels to see tag fragmentation.

Diego: I can already see many VMs missing the canonical cost tag. They have `team=search` but `cost_center` is null or `costCenter` (old key). That breaks FinOps mapping and can exclude instances from our project-level CUDs.

Nora: Quick query I ran (gcp billing export):
```
SELECT labels, SUM(cost) as total_cost
FROM `billing.gcp_export`
WHERE resource_type = 'gce_instance'
  AND DATE(_PARTITIONTIME) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  AND region = 'us-west1'
GROUP BY labels
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Results show a bunch of high-cost rows with `labels.cost_center` = NULL.

Arun: Also found a recent reservation purchase we made last week (res-1732) in us-east1 to cover a burst. Reservations/CUDs are region-scoped, so that wouldn't apply to the us-west on-demand spend — explains part of the gap.

Maya: So hypothesis = (1) tag key mismatch / missing labels causing misattribution, (2) region mismatch of reservation purchases leaving us exposed in us-west1.

Lena: Confirmed. Our autoscaler templated nodepool creates GCE instances with `owner=platform` but the new cost tag wasn't added because the templating library used `costCenter` historically. We rolled to `cost_center` in infra-migration but some nodepools still use the old template.

Diego: I'll run a targeted backfill to patch instance labels for the past 30 days and generate a list for chargeback. Patch script (pseudo):
```bash
# find untagged instances in us-west1, backfill from metadata 'owner' mapping
gcloud compute instances list --filter='zone:(us-west1-*) AND labels.cost_center=""' --format='value(name,zone,labels)' | while read name zone labels; do
  gcloud compute instances add-labels $name --zone=$zone --labels=cost_center=search
done
```
Will run in dry-run first.

Nora: Preliminary back-of-envelope: after patch and re-run of allocation rules, ~ $18k looks re-allocable to Search (tag fix), and an additional ~$6.5k is attributable to CUD/reservation misapplication (region mismatch). Total ~ $24.5k potential reallocation/credit pending finance review.

Maya: Good. Please create a ticket and export the instance list + costs. We need an internal chargeback note to Search and a short remediation plan.

Arun: Created INFRA-2783 with the CSV export attached and PR that updates the nodepool templates to use `cost_center` consistently. Also added an admission webhook PR to require `cost_center` on instance create.

Diego: Deployed backfill job to staging; will run nightly with a safety window and audit logs. Admission controller patch is in canary in `infra-test` cluster. If it passes, I'll roll to prod tomorrow morning.

billing-bot: Drafted chargeback memo at /docs/chargebacks/INFRA-2783-search-gpu-reallocation.md — includes estimated credit $24,500 and breakdown (tag backfill $18,000, reservation shortfall $6,500). Waiting on finance signoff.

Sam: Please attach the reservation purchase rationale/decision record so finance has context on why res-1732 was bought in us-east1. We need the audit trail.

Maya: Attached decision notes and the Slack convo to the ticket. Action items: 1) backfill labels (Arun/Diego), 2) admission webhook enforcement (Arun), 3) reservation strategy review (Maya/Finance), 4) chargeback memo + finance signoff (billing-bot/Nora).

Lena: Also adding a small UX change to dust off our provisioning docs so new nodepool templates include `cost_center` by default. PR opened.

Diego: Ran dry-run backfill, no errors. Patch will retro-tag ~420 instances (last 30 days) in us-west1. Estimate reallocation run completes in ~2 hours once we flip to live.

Nora: After live backfill run completed: updated allocation report. Reallocable = $17,980. Reservation mismatch impact unchanged at ~$6,520. Leaving rounding -> $24,500.

Maya: Finance notified, waiting on signoff. Once approved we'll communicate the credit to Search and schedule a post-mortem on provisioning/tagging.

billings-bot: NOTE: make sure to include the invoice period and the reservation invoice IDs for audit.

Maya: Will do. Thanks all. Closing thread once finance confirms. :white_check_mark:
